recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. If the work group still wants a formal OperationDefinition.parameter.binding value set for contextDirection, handle it as a new or explicitly confirmed tracker because FHIR-18047 itself is already satisfied by current source.
issue_request: FHIR-18047 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request from STU3 asking that ValueSet.$expand contextDirection clearly highlight its valid values, incoming and outgoing. The approved resolution was to make the values a bulleted list and defer any value-set work.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git 66ae1e40f1bc02283363c872db14035fc795f8f7, a terminology ballot reconciliation commit that included GF#18047 with adjacent ValueSet.$expand guidance work. The current standalone OperationDefinition source was later regenerated/refactored, but it preserves the applied contextDirection wording as a two-item list.
additional_context: FHIR-17321 introduced the contextDirection parameter and its incoming/outgoing meaning. Active fhir.ini entries keep ValueSet and OperationDefinition in the current build and map ValueSet to vocab. A later proposal, FHIR-24834, to add contextDirection=existing was retracted/no-change, and community/Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-18047 record or conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml already states "Valid values are" followed by bullet entries for 'incoming' and 'outgoing'. Adding a new binding/value set now would exceed the specific published FHIR-18047 resolution without a clear later work-group decision.
